---
title: "Contact"
---

CoDIN Press currently receives publication and technical enquiries through the [CoDIN-Press organization on GitHub](https://github.com/CoDIN-Press).

- For a problem with this portal, open an issue in the `CoDIN-Press.github.io` repository.
- For a correction or accessibility issue in a particular publication, use that publication’s source-repository link.
- Do not post private, culturally restricted, legally sensitive or personally identifying material in a public issue. In such cases, first request an appropriate private contact channel without including the sensitive information.
